Jordan / Alice — answers inline below, and I’ve assigned Neha to send the full spreadsheet and kick off the questionnaire.

> Are any subprocessors (or backups) located outside the US?
Yes — our subprocessor list includes a mix of US and non-US vendors. Core hosting for hosted API is on AWS (us-west-2) and we use a managed CDN provider with global PoPs. Non-US subprocessors are primarily for monitoring, error-tracking, and analytics (names in the attached PDF). We will flag any vendors that process or store customer content outside agreed regions.

> For HIPAA: can you confirm if Redwood offers a BAA for Hosted + Dedicated, or only Dedicated/Private?
Short answer: BAAs are supported for Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted API is not covered by default for PHI unless we set up a scoped, contractual arrangement (we can discuss). If you need a BAA, we’ll route this to Legal — please confirm so we can prioritize.

> Where is customer data persisted for the hosted API? S3? Log retention?
Customer request payloads are stored transiently in S3-backed object stores in us-west-2 for hosted customers; runtime logs are retained for 30 days by default (configurable). We can offer longer retention or log-forwarding to your SIEM on Dedicated deployments.

Neha — can you: 1) send the detailed subprocessor spreadsheet to Jordan + Alice, 2) open the questionnaire in the link Marissa shared and invite alice.turner@acmecorp.com, target complete by 3/9?

Marissa
